turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, I'm the attorney representing your granddaughter after her DUI arrest.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: She called crying earlier. Is she okay?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She's fine but bail is $7,000 by wire within the hour, or she's held over the weekend.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The judge ordered a gag on the case, so please don't call the court or tell relatives.
